test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two students A and B appeared in a class test. B scored 40% of the sum total of their marks, which is 7 less than the marks of A. How many marks did B score?
solution:
**Given:**

B scored 40% of the sum total of their marks, which is 7 less than the marks of A.

**Calculation:**

Marks of A = Marks of B + 7

According to the question,

B = (A + B) × 40/100

⇒ B = 2A/5 + 2B/5

⇒ B – 2B/5 = 2A/5

⇒ (5B - 2B)/5 = 2A/5

⇒ 3B/5 = 2A/5

⇒ A/B = 3/2 = 3 : 2

Difference of marks = (3 - 2) = 1 unit = 7 marks

⇒ The marks of B (2 units) = 2 × 7 = 14 marks

**∴ B scored 14.**
